description: Signed mode packages (protocol/mode-packages.md, decisions P5R-7, P5B-10, P5C-8 to P5C-13). Made by tools/mode_package_vectors.py; checked by controller/tests/test_mode_package.py (the shared Python of controller/atalaia_controller/mode_package.py) and, from phase 5 plan phase 13, by the Field Box. rfc8032: RFC 8032 section 7.1's TEST 1 and 2, copied from the RFC. signing_key is TEST 1's key and other_key TEST 2's: public test keys, never mode keys. archive: the canonical ustar archive of the files under its id (read back by Python's tarfile too). archives_invalid: archives every reader refuses, with the code. releases: manifests of that archive signed with signing_key, some changed after signing. verify: whole checks (archive, release, trusted keys, revoked ids) and their result. release_texts_invalid: texts a reader refuses. index and index_invalid: the registry index (registry/schema/index.schema.json); revoked: a revocation list. Phase 5 plan phase 13 (a box fetching the modes it lacks, protocol/mode-packages.md, decisions P5B-10 to P5B-16, P5D-*): box_limits; box_checks: a Field Box's checks in its order (release_text, the part it asked for wanted_id, its mode keys, its tier, its built-in ids), then of the archive it downloaded (archive: 'archive', 'tampered', 'truncated' (the valid one less its last block) or archive_hex; null: refused before any download), with the result (ok, with the signer's key_id and the files kept, or the refusal's code); reports: a box's reports with their HMAC-SHA256 under game_key, and bodies to refuse.
